question: What pricing applies to batch processing requests in Claude?
answer:
The Batches API charges all usage at **50% of standard API prices**. Here are the batch rates for key models:

| Model | Batch Input | Batch Output |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Opus 4.7 | $2.50 / MTok | $12.50 / MTok |
| Claude Sonnet 4.6 | $1.50 / MTok | $7.50 / MTok |
| Claude Haiku 4.5 | $0.50 / MTok | $2.50 / MTok |
| Claude Haiku 3.5 | $0.40 / MTok | $2 / MTok |

(Additional models are listed in the full pricing table.)

Note that for extended output (beta), standard batch pricing of 50% of standard API prices also applies.
